title: Jotai
description: A primitive and flexible state management library for React.

data.text: Jotai is a state management library for React with an atom-based architecture inspired by Recoil. It provides a minimal API for managing state at any scale, from simple UI state to complex application state.

data.title: Creating an Atom
data.content: Define a primitive atom and a derived atom.

data.title: Atoms
data.text: Atoms are the smallest unit of state in Jotai. Derived atoms compute their value from other atoms.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Jotai uses atoms as the unit of state
Derived atoms compute from other atoms
Minimal API with excellent TypeScript support
data.takeaway: Jotai provides a simple, atomic approach to React state management.
